{{Quote|At the Chorax system you have us skirting it by .25 parsecs. There's only one planetary mass in that system and the sun isn't that big.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="XW:RS" />}}
The '''Chorax system''' was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]' [[Rachuk sector/Legends|Rachuk sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> between [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] and [[Talasea]]. Its sole planet was [[Chorax]],<ref name="XW:RS" /><ref name="TCSWE" /> and the yellow<ref name="XW:TBW" /><ref name="TCSWE" /> sun was not massive,<ref name="XW:RS" /><ref name="TCSWE" /> meaning that starships could skim it close through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="XW:RS" /> It was known as a hotbed of [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]]<ref name="XW:RS" /><ref name="TCSWE" /> and was thus avoided by merchant ships.<ref name="XW:RS" />

In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], during the [[Core Campaign]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Corusca Rainbow|''Black Asp'']] [[Battle in the Chorax system|ambushed]] the [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Pulsar Skate]]'' in the system.<ref name="XW:RS" /> During the [[Bacta War]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Raid on Thyferran Convoy Delta-Two-Niner|raided]] the [[Thyferran Convoy Delta-Two-Niner]] in the Chorax system.<ref name="XW:TBW" />
